measurement_description: The paper does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. Its focus is on the safety of tool utilization by LLMs, with risk categories including Privacy Leak, Property Damage, Physical Injury, and a general category of Bias & Offensiveness that was not applied to religious contexts in this study.
